response.sql: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId), cross_media_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_rate FROM media_type_stats) SELECT AVG(s.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(s.bytes_per_millisecond) AS avg_bytes_per_millisecond, AVG(s.bytes_per_millisecond - c.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_cross_media_avg FROM media_type_stats AS s CROSS JOIN cross_media_avg AS c WHERE s.bytes_per_millisecond > c.avg_rate;
